next.reason: 1985: 'PROGRAM-ID. program-name [IS {COMMON INITIAL} PROGRAM].' with COMMON and INITIAL in choice indicators. §2023:11.10.2 Format 1 (definition), restated in the program-definition of §2023:10.6.1, keeps COMMON and INITIAL in any order but adds '[AS literal-1]' and the RECURSIVE alternative. No other 1985 rule allows AS or RECURSIVE. Every 1985 paragraph keeps its meaning; more are accepted. CHANGED (looser).
